map.给定应力与截面积求可承受的拉力。: Given stress and cross-sectional area, find the sustainable tensile force.
map.由拉力与截面积求正应力: Normal stress from force and area
map.sigma = F / A。10kN 拉力作用于 100mm2 截面：sigma: sigma = F / A. A 10 kN force on a 100 mm² section gives sigma = 100 MPa. A smaller A raises stress under the same force, more likely exceeding strength.
map.sigma 超过屈服强度开始塑性变形，超过抗拉强度则断裂；设计留安全系数。: When sigma exceeds yield strength, plastic deformation begins; beyond tensile strength it fractures; design with a safety factor.
map.应力和压强一样吗？: Is stress the same as pressure?
map.量纲相同（力/面积），但应力是内力分布（可拉可剪可压），压强常指流体外压；固体力: Same dimension (force/area), but stress is internal force distribution (tension, shear or compression) whereas pressure usually means external fluid pressure; solid mechanics uses stress.
map.为什么截面突变处易断？: Why do cross-section transitions break easily?
map.使局部 sigma 远高于名义值，裂纹从缺口起裂；故避免尖角、用圆角过渡。: It makes local sigma far above the nominal value, with cracks initiating at notches; hence avoid sharp corners and use fillet transitions.
